exposure: maternal prescriptions for fibrates in the first trimester
cohort: A cohort of 756,877 completed pregnancies linked to live-born infants in 215,600 women with dyslipidemia in South Korea between 2012 and 2021.
finding: The study found no significant difference in the prevalence of malformations between offspring exposed to fibrates during the first trimester (10.77%) and unexposed offspring (9.68%) in women with dyslipidemia.
